repos.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
repos.description: The agent that grows with you
repos.one_liner: A highly adaptive, evolving AI agent framework designed for complex task orchestration.
bullets: Built on a modular Python architecture designed for continuous learning and state management.
Focuses on agentic workflows that scale in complexity alongside user requirements.
Ideal for automating multi-step research, coding, or data analysis tasks.
Leverages advanced LLM reasoning to maintain context across long-running operations.

repos.name: tinyhumansai/openhuman
repos.description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. A brain that builds a local-first memory of your life, a fantastic orchestrator of agent fleets and workflows, and a deep researcher.
repos.one_liner: A local-first personal AI orchestrator that builds a persistent memory of your digital life.
bullets: Written in Rust for high-performance, memory-safe execution and local data privacy.
Functions as a central brain for managing agent fleets and complex automated workflows.
Provides deep research capabilities by indexing local-first memory stores.
Targeted at power users needing a private, persistent AI assistant for personal knowledge management.

repos.name: wafer-ai/gpu-perf-engineering-resources
repos.description: A curriculum for learning about gpu performance engineering, from scratch to what the frontier AI labs do
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive curriculum for mastering GPU performance engineering at the scale of frontier AI labs.
bullets: Curated educational path covering hardware architecture, CUDA optimization, and kernel tuning.
Focuses on the critical infrastructure layer required to train and serve large-scale LLMs.
Provides actionable insights into reducing latency and compute costs for AI workloads.
Essential for quant developers and infra engineers working on high-throughput AI systems.

repos.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
repos.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repos.one_liner: An AI agent framework optimized for minimalist, high-efficiency code generation.
bullets: Implements a 'lazy' heuristic to prioritize existing solutions and minimal code footprint.
Designed to integrate into developer workflows to reduce technical debt and bloat.
Utilizes LLM reasoning to evaluate whether a feature is necessary before implementation.
Useful for rapid prototyping and maintaining clean, maintainable codebases.

repos.name: virgiliojr94/book-to-skill
repos.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
repos.one_liner: A tool that converts technical PDF documentation into executable Claude Code skills.
bullets: Python-based pipeline for parsing technical literature and transforming it into structured agent instructions.
Enables AI agents to reference domain-specific knowledge bases during coding or troubleshooting.
Streamlines the onboarding of new technical stacks by turning static manuals into active agent capabilities.
Highly relevant for fintech and quant teams needing to integrate proprietary documentation into AI workflows.
